repairs.quote: Wukong gains (6 ~ 10) Armor and regenerates 0.35% max Health per 5 seconds. These bonuses are increased by 100% for 5 seconds every time he or his Clone hit an enemy champion or jungle monster with an Attack or Ability, stacking up to 5 times.
